card.name: The start of the word risk
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word risk (Ris, R, ris) when it is split up, often in headings or all-caps warnings, just before the rest of 'risk' or 'risks' appears.

modes.label: Split 'Ris' in headings
modes.description: 'Ris' begins 'Risks' in section titles like drug interaction headings.
modes.example: 7.1 Drugs That May Increase<< Ris>>ks due to Fluid and Electrolyte

modes.label: Split 'R' in capitals or hyphens
modes.description: A lone 'R' or '-R' begins RISK in all-caps warnings or 'at-risk' phrases.
modes.example: WARNING: (A) PREMATURE DISCONTINUATION OF XARELTO INCREASES THE<< R>>ISK OF THROMBOTIC EVENTS,

modes.label: Word before risk
modes.description: A small word such as 'at' directly before 'risk'.
modes.example: other close contacts<< at>> risk for accidental ingestion or overdose.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output risk, risks or the Chinese word for risk next.
card.plain: It fires when the word 'risk' is about to be spelled out, especially when it is broken into pieces.
